rca of the issue: Root cause: ProviderDashboard.jsx re-render pass added the vertical-conditional check for KPI tiles (line 94) and lifetime strip (line 110), and toggled the grid column count based on vertical (line 119), but forgot to wrap the actual Fleet <section> tag (lines 138-152).
